plan.title: Reopened PR Line Item Can Be Processed

steps.note: Open the purchase requisitions screen where the held line item can be reopened.

args.goal: Reopen the held purchase-request line item by choosing “Re-open Item”, then “Reopen Item”, and stop when the screen proves the item is reopened.

steps.note: No catalog domain step performs the reopen-item interaction, so execute and verify that buyer-side action on screen.
Use the Open tab because only open requisitions can be processed into sourcing events.
Select the reopened requisition and verify that its Purchase Items action becomes available.
Start processing the selected requisition into a sourcing event.
Assert that the reopened line item is present on the new event's create screen, proving it was available for buying again.
